# Actions (generated by `defios registry export`; do not edit)

One section per card. Plan one with `defios plan <card>.<action>=<amount> [--token T]`:
`input` is what the amount is in, `--token` picks one entry of `tokens`,
each `--param` name must be given as `--param name=value`.

## aave: Aave (governance, staking, GHO)

| action | input | tokens | --param | does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `stake_aave` | AAVE |  |  | AAVE -> stkAAVE (Safety Module), credited to the Vault |
| `cooldown_stkaave` |  |  |  | start the stkAAVE cooldown for the Vault's whole balance (needed before unstake) |
| `unstake_aave` | stkAAVE |  |  | stkAAVE -> AAVE after the cooldown, paid to the Vault |
| `claim_stkaave_rewards` |  |  |  | claim all AAVE rewards accrued on stkAAVE, paid to the Vault |
| `claim_and_stake_stkaave_rewards` |  |  |  | claim the AAVE rewards accrued on stkAAVE and stake them straight back into stkAAVE for the Vault |
| `deposit_sgho` | GHO |  |  | GHO -> sGho (savings GHO), credited to the Vault |
| `withdraw_sgho` | GHO |  |  | sGho -> an exact amount of GHO, paid to the Vault |
| `redeem_sgho` | sGho |  |  | an exact number of sGho shares -> GHO, paid to the Vault |

## aave_v3: Aave v3 (Ethereum core market)

| action | input | tokens | --param | does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `supply` |  | USDC, USDT, DAI, USDS, GHO, PYUSD, USDe, sUSDe |  | token -> aToken (collateral), credited to the Vault |
| `withdraw` |  | USDC, USDT, DAI, USDS, GHO, PYUSD, USDe, sUSDe |  | aToken -> token, paid to the Vault |
| `borrow` |  | USDC, USDT, DAI, USDS, GHO, PYUSD, USDe |  | borrow token at variable rate against the Vault's collateral; paid to the Vault |
| `repay` |  | USDC, USDT, DAI, USDS, GHO, PYUSD, USDe |  | repay the Vault's variable debt in token |
| `repay_with_atokens` |  | USDC, USDT, DAI, USDS, GHO, PYUSD, USDe |  | repay the Vault's debt in token with its aTokens of the same token (no approve) |
| `set_emode` |  |  | category | switch the Vault's e-mode category (0 = none) |
| `enable_collateral` |  | USDC, USDT, DAI, USDS, GHO, PYUSD, USDe, sUSDe |  | use a supplied token as collateral |
| `disable_collateral` |  | USDC, USDT, DAI, USDS, GHO, PYUSD, USDe, sUSDe |  | stop using a supplied token as collateral |
| `supply_other` |  | WETH, wstETH, weETH, cbETH, WBTC, cbBTC, LBTC, tBTC, eBTC, LINK, AAVE, LDO, tETH, RLUSD, USDtb, EURC, USDG, rETH, osETH |  | token -> receipt token (collateral when enabled), credited to the Vault |
| `withdraw_other` |  | WETH, wstETH, weETH, cbETH, WBTC, cbBTC, LBTC, tBTC, eBTC, LINK, AAVE, LDO, tETH, RLUSD, USDtb, EURC, USDG, ezETH, rsETH, sDAI, crvUSD, FRAX, CRV, BAL, rETH, osETH, ETHx |  | receipt token -> token, paid to the Vault |
| `borrow_other` |  | WETH, WBTC, cbBTC, tBTC, LINK, RLUSD, USDtb, EURC, USDG |  | borrow token at variable rate against the Vault's collateral; paid to the Vault |
| `repay_other` |  | WETH, WBTC, cbBTC, tBTC, LINK, RLUSD, USDtb, EURC, USDG |  | repay the Vault's variable debt in token |
| `repay_with_atokens_other` |  | WETH, WBTC, cbBTC, tBTC, LINK, RLUSD, USDtb, EURC, USDG |  | repay the Vault's debt in token with its receipt tokens of the same token (no approve) |
| `enable_collateral_other` |  | WETH, wstETH, weETH, cbETH, WBTC, cbBTC, LBTC, tBTC, eBTC, LINK, AAVE, LDO, tETH, RLUSD, USDtb, EURC, USDG, rETH, osETH |  | use a supplied token as collateral |
| `disable_collateral_other` |  | WETH, wstETH, weETH, cbETH, WBTC, cbBTC, LBTC, tBTC, eBTC, LINK, AAVE, LDO, tETH, RLUSD, USDtb, EURC, USDG, ezETH, rsETH, sDAI, crvUSD, FRAX, CRV, BAL, rETH, osETH, ETHx |  | stop using a supplied token as collateral |
| `supply_eth` | ETH |  |  | ETH -> aEthWETH (collateral) through the WETH gateway, credited to the Vault |
| `withdraw_eth` | aEthWETH |  |  | aEthWETH -> ETH through the WETH gateway, paid to the Vault |
| `borrow_eth` | WETH |  |  | borrow WETH at variable rate and receive it as ETH in the Vault |
| `repay_eth` | ETH |  |  | repay the Vault's variable WETH debt with ETH through the WETH gateway |
| `claim_rewards` |  |  | asset, reward | claim one reward token accrued on one aToken / debt token, paid to the Vault |

## aave_v4: Aave v4 (Spoke, core hub)

| action | input | tokens | --param | does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `supply` |  | USDC, USDT, DAI, USDS, GHO, PYUSD, USDe, sUSDe | reserve_id | token -> Spoke reserve `reserve_id` for the Vault (pass --param reserve_id=<id of that token's reserve>) |
| `withdraw` |  |  | reserve_id | withdraw from reserve `reserve_id`; paid to msg.sender (the Vault) |
| `borrow` |  |  | reserve_id | borrow from reserve `reserve_id`; paid to msg.sender (the Vault) |
| `repay` |  | USDC, USDT, DAI, USDS, GHO, PYUSD, USDe | reserve_id | repay the Vault's debt on reserve `reserve_id` |
| `enable_collateral` |  |  | reserve_id | use reserve `reserve_id` as collateral |
| `disable_collateral` |  |  | reserve_id | stop using reserve `reserve_id` as collateral |
| `update_risk_premium` |  |  |  | refresh the Vault's risk premium |
| `update_dynamic_config` |  |  |  | refresh the Vault's dynamic reserve config |

## avant: Avant (avETH / savETH)

| action | input | tokens | --param | does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `stake` |  |  |  | avETH -> savETH |
| `cooldown` |  |  |  | exit step 1 (needs cooldownDuration > 0): burn shares, escrow avETH in the silo |
| `unstake` |  |  |  | exit step 2, after cooldownEnd: silo pays avETH to receiver |
| `instant_exit` |  |  |  | only works when Avant sets cooldownDuration == 0 |
| `mint` |  |  |  | WETH -> avETH via Avant RFQ |
| `redeem` |  |  |  | avETH -> WETH via Avant RFQ |

## balancer_v3: Balancer v3 (Vault, routers, pools)

| action | input | tokens | --param | does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Aave_GHO_USDT_USDC_add_USDT` | USDT |  | min_bpt | USDT -> Aave_GHO_USDT_USDC BPT (single-sided; the router wraps it into the Aave wrapper), minted to the Vault |
| `Aave_GHO_USDT_USDC_add_GHO` | GHO |  | min_bpt | GHO -> Aave_GHO_USDT_USDC BPT (single-sided; the router wraps it into the Aave wrapper), minted to the Vault |
| `Aave_GHO_USDT_USDC_add_USDC` | USDC |  | min_bpt | USDC -> Aave_GHO_USDT_USDC BPT (single-sided; the router wraps it into the Aave wrapper), minted to the Vault |
| `Aave_GHO_USDT_USDC_remove` | Aave_GHO_USDT_USDC |  | min0, min1, min2 | Aave_GHO_USDT_USDC BPT -> USDT, GHO and USDC in pool proportions (unwrapped by the router), paid to the Vault |
| `osETH_waWETH_remove` | osETH_waWETH |  | min0, min1 | osETH_waWETH BPT -> waEthWETH and osETH in pool proportions, paid to the Vault |
| `osETH_waWETH_remove_waEthWETH` | osETH_waWETH |  | min_out | osETH_waWETH BPT -> waEthWETH only, paid to the Vault |
| `rETH_waEthWETH_remove` | rETH_waEthWETH |  | min0, min1 | rETH_waEthWETH BPT -> waEthWETH and rETH in pool proportions, paid to the Vault |
| `rETH_waEthWETH_remove_waEthWETH` | rETH_waEthWETH |  | min_out | rETH_waEthWETH BPT -> waEthWETH only, paid to the Vault |
| `waEthWETH_unwrap` | waEthWETH |  |  | waEthWETH -> WETH back to the Vault |
| `Aave_GHO_USDT_USDC_stake` | Aave_GHO_USDT_USDC |  |  | Aave_GHO_USDT_USDC BPT -> Aave_GHO_USDT_USDC_gauge (earns BAL) |
| `osETH_waWETH_stake` | osETH_waWETH |  |  | osETH_waWETH BPT -> osETH_waWETH_gauge (earns BAL) |
| `rETH_waEthWETH_stake` | rETH_waEthWETH |  |  | rETH_waEthWETH BPT -> rETH_waEthWETH_gauge (earns BAL) |
| `unstake` |  | Aave_GHO_USDT_USDC_gauge, osETH_waWETH_gauge, rETH_waEthWETH_gauge |  | gauge token -> its BPT back to the Vault |
| `claim_bal` |  | Aave_GHO_USDT_USDC_gauge, osETH_waWETH_gauge, rETH_waEthWETH_gauge |  | BAL emissions of one gauge -> the Vault |
| `claim_rewards` |  | Aave_GHO_USDT_USDC_gauge, osETH_waWETH_gauge, rETH_waEthWETH_gauge |  | extra (non-BAL) gauge rewards -> the Vault |

## cowswap: CoW Swap (pre-signed orders via the CowswapOrderSigner)

| action | input | tokens | --param | does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `swap` |  |  | buy_token, min_out, sell_token | sell token -> buy token via a pre-signed CoW order, proceeds to the Avatar |
| `cancel` |  |  | buy_token, sell_token | withdraw a pre-signed order |

## curve: Curve (pools, gauges, CRV, veCRV)

| action | input | tokens | --param | does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `steth_pool_add_ETH` | ETH |  | min_lp | ETH -> steCRV (single-sided add to steth_pool), minted to the Vault |
| `steth_pool_add_stETH` | stETH |  | min_lp | stETH -> steCRV (single-sided add to steth_pool), minted to the Vault |
| `steth_pool_remove_one` | steCRV |  | i, min_out | steCRV -> one coin of steth_pool (pick it with i), paid to the Vault |

| action | input | tokens | --param | does |

| `borrow` |  | WETH, wstETH, cbBTC, USDC, DAI, USDT, PYUSD, USDS, RLUSD, USDG |  | borrow token at variable rate against the Vault's collateral; paid to the Vault |
| `repay` |  | WETH, wstETH, cbBTC, USDC, DAI, USDT, PYUSD, USDS, RLUSD, USDG, tBTC |  | repay the Vault's variable debt in token |
| `repay_with_atokens` |  | WETH, wstETH, cbBTC, USDC, DAI, USDT, PYUSD, USDS, RLUSD, USDG, tBTC |  | repay the Vault's debt in token with its receipt tokens of the same token (no approve) |
